comment: Blamsoft publish no source for this plugin. Panel artwork draws a line from each CV jack to the knob it feeds, and every one is right. Decay times come from a custom ParamQuantity computing 0.5 * 2^(6v) seconds; damping 1.5 * 10^(1.166v) kHz; crossover 50 * 10^(1.301v) Hz; mod rate 5 * 10^(1.6v - 1) Hz; delay and the two percentage knobs are linear. Each CV is added to the knob value at 0.1 per volt and the sum is clamped to the knob's own 0 to 1 range, so the CV cannot push a control past its limits. The Enable switch is configured with a default of 1, so a newly added module already passes signal through the reverb; nothing has to be switched on first. The widget adds no context menu of its own, so the module carries only Rack's standard one. The maker's PDF manual was read on this pass with pypdf. It agrees with the entry throughout and adds nothing already here: it names no menu item, states no range, and describes no step the user has to take before the module passes signal. Its only fact not already here is that the algorithm is the one Blamsoft shipped in the Expanse Hyperwave Rack Extension for Reason, which says nothing about using this module.
